enrichment.null_model: chromosome-stratified random placement preserving each locus width and chromosome; point records remain zero-width points
enrichment.interpretation_limit: Overlap validates positional recurrence, not causality. Broad LD/linkage spans increase expected random overlap and are preserved in the null model.

sensitivity.primary_null_model: For each dataset family and chromosome, apply one random circular shift to every locus, preserving within-family chromosome-specific widths, counts, clustering and relative spacing; split wrapped intervals at chromosome boundaries.
sensitivity.interpretation: Family-level inference is primary for independence. Locus-level P-values are descriptive because multiple loci within a data family are correlated.
